title: PCP Entry Frontmatter Schema
description: Normative schema for structured entry metadata headers across PCP Markdown components (RFC-0001).

id.description: Unique identifier composed of uppercase prefix and numeric counter (e.g. DEC-0001, ARCH-0001).

title.description: Concise human-readable title for the entry.

status.description: Standardized lifecycle status of the entry.

updated_at.description: Last update date in ISO 8601 (YYYY-MM-DD) format.

date.description: Alias for created_at used in decision records.

contributors.description: List of contributing entities (human, AI, or automation).

supersedes.description: ID of previous entry superseded by this entry.

superseded_by.description: ID of subsequent entry that supersedes this entry.
